answer: Mechanism: horizon-chained unique-answer tickets. Each epoch, an agent must publish a fresh solution to H(prev_ticket‖ephemeral_pubkey‖epoch‖summit_hash‖sparrow_salt) below target; the append-only log accepts each exact solution once. Copied, replayed, or duplicate answers fail. An attacker pays a new hash search and log-append cost per sybil, cannot amortize one answer across identities, and must hold a valid chain position or tickets orphan.
